title: No pipelines on a burning planet. No to Keystone XL!
text:
Sign the petition

Donald Trump is threatening to revive the Keystone XL pipeline, even as our communities are reeling from a summer of fossil-fueled heatwaves, wildfires and smoke.

But Keystone XL was a bad idea when it was first proposed in 2008, and it’s a worse idea now. Building KXL, or any new pipelines, would be like pouring fuel on the flames of the climate emergency.

We’ve stopped Keystone XL before – and this is the moment we’re made for. 350 Canada and 350 US are joining forces to tell Prime Minister Carney: No pipelines on a burning planet. NO to Keystone XL.

View the full petition text.

Tell Prime Minister Carney: Say NO to KXL

To Prime Minister Carney:

The Keystone XL pipeline (under any name) would be a disaster for our climate and our communities. The facts of this project haven’t changed since it was first proposed in 2008:

I stand with the Indigenous land defenders, local communities, and climate advocates in Canada and the U.S. who have spent more than a decade fighting the Keystone XL pipeline. No pipelines on a burning planet. NO to Keystone XL.

Sincerely,

Tell Prime Minister Carney: Say NO to KXL
